notes: Company: mid-market B2B dev tools; chat/code assistant embedded in web IDE and support portal.
Hosted trial has real traffic shape: ~70% short interactions (40-180 tokens), 30% long generation (600-1500 tokens).
Token mix observed: avg request tokens (in+out) ~420 tokens; monthly trial extrapolation => ~120M tokens/month at current usage.
Latency requirement: p95 < 250ms for short chat path; p95 < 1.2s acceptable for long generations.
Throughput ask for Dedicated: baseline 40 QPS sustained, burstable to 140 QPS for 5-10 minute peaks. Concurrency target ~60.
Cost sensitivity: finance wants forecasted unit cost <= current hosted spend * 0.85 (i.e., ~15% savings required) to justify committed Dedicated contract.
Preferences: prefer open model variants we verified; will accept quantized variants if quality delta <3% on eval set.
Routing: want latency-first routing for EU customers, cost-first for non-sensitive batch jobs; automatic fallback to smaller model if capacity constrained.
Security: must support customer-managed KMS, SAML SSO, and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. Data residency: primary US, subset EU for EU customers.
Quote from CTO: "We need predictable economics and a path off noisy multi-tenant spikes — Dedicated looks promising if sizing/price align."
capacity_sizing_notes: Observed trial baseline: 14 avg QPS -> extrapolated production baseline target = 40 QPS (buffer x2.8 for growth + safety).
Peak planning: 140 QPS for short windows; recommend Dedicated pool baseline 4 x A100-class GPUs with autoscale to 8 for peak bursts (estimate).
Concurrency mapping: 40 QPS baseline approximates ~25-35 concurrent sessions for mixed token lengths; plan for 60 concurrent headroom.
Token throughput: forecast 6-8B tokens/month at target scale (customer estimate based on product roadmap).
Caching: large fraction (30%) of traffic is predictable completions — prefix caching could cut effective token spend ~12-18%.
Batching: background reranking/embeddings jobs can be scheduled to off-peak nodes (cost-first pool).
Suggested rollout: start with 3-month Dedicated trial (1yr pricing band if conversion) with canary routing 10% traffic to Dedicated, ramp to 100% over 4 weeks.
Open question: exact GPU SKU mapping and perf profile for the preferred model variant (SE to request model perf matrix from infra team).
